content.value: During the summer of 2026, I interned at AXXS Digital, a Caribbean-focused studio that combines brand communication, strategy, and software to help clients navigate complex business challenges and digital change.

, I split my time between brand and product work: Parlour Caribbean’s rebrand and new features for The Gazette app. Across both projects, the aim was clear information hierarchy, cohesive visual systems, and interfaces tuned to Caribbean users and contexts.
